sentences.en: I bought a packet of lettuce seeds for the garden.
sentences.zh: 为了花园我买了一包生菜种子。

sentences.en: Soon you are going to receive a valuable packet.
sentences.zh: 很快你就会收到一个贵重的小包裹。

sentences.en: Luckily, I have instant coffee packets in my bag.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我的包里有速溶咖啡小袋。

senses.zh: 数据包，信息包；小包，小捆 -
